case.shape_origin: H3 grouped Q/K/V projection; synthetic BF16 activations/weights/gamma/trig tables

configuration.order: first backend alternates every pair; same runner and resident buffers throughout
configuration.primary_timing: synchronized host wall around NativeCall plus engine.evaluate only
configuration.supplemental_timing: GPU command start/end duration, read after the host timer

promotion_requires: second seed and independent rerun on identical hardware

preparation_metadata.execution_driver: same Objective-C Metal device/queue, buffers, command-buffer boundaries and safe compiler options

upstream.shader_policy: load verified upstream source bytes unchanged

backend_provenance.environment_policy: fixed upstream defaults; all external H3 feature flags ignored
backend_provenance.timing_scope: synchronized host wall; one command buffer; no output reads
backend_provenance.input_and_weight_precision: BF16 -> native scalar symmetric INT8 + FP32 row scales

preparation_metadata.reference: NumPy float64 full-K projection for complete sampled Q/K/V heads, explicit BF16 projection/output
preparation_metadata.weight_layout: native grouped [head,Q/K/V,128,K] supplied identically to both paths
preparation_metadata.output_layout_conversion: included in each projection epilogue; no omitted transpose or V cost
preparation_metadata.projection_rounding: BF16 after FP32 per-row/per-output-channel dequantization, before Q/K RMS
preparation_metadata.normalization_rounding: none; FP32 gamma/RoPE before BF16 Q/K output
preparation_metadata.v_policy: BF16 projection only, no normalization or RoPE
preparation_metadata.rope_table_origin: synthetic independent angles, not a model position trace
preparation_metadata.quantization_policy: native reciprocal-multiply W8A8, scalar quantizer, clip1, no Hadamard
preparation_metadata.main_timing_scope: resident packed activation, grouped Q/K/V projection, Q/K RMS/RoPE and all three head-major BF16 outputs
preparation_metadata.online_timing_scope: native BF16 activation INT8 quantization including padded rows + entire grouped QKV core
preparation_metadata.offline_weight_preparation: same native BF16-to-INT8 scalar quantizer on grouped weights

paired_speed_ratio.definition: native synchronized wall / candidate synchronized wall; >1 favors candidate

publication.policy: Compiler installation path omitted; numerical data, timing samples, source hashes and versions unchanged. Original local record retained immutably.
